title: Antenatal Clinic Visit
description: Prepare for your antenatal clinic visit.
checklist_items: Carry your ANC card or any previous hospital record.
Have a small bottle of water and a light snack.
Note down any unusual symptoms to mention to the nurse.
Arrange transport to and from the clinic.

title: Child Immunization Visit
description: Things to prepare when taking your child for immunization.
checklist_items: Dress the child in easy-to-remove clothing.
Carry a light snack or toy to calm the child.
Have some cash or health insurance card ready.
